name: MCP cross-harness setup & registry listing
description:
Make Agent Plan discoverable and installable across MCP-capable harnesses (Claude Code, Codex/Copilot CLI, Cursor, Zed, etc.). Includes: 1) project/user setup commands that generate local MCP server config (`agent-plan setup claude-code`, `agent-plan setup codex`), and 2) publishing a public listing to the official Model Context Protocol registry so clients can install without a harness-specific plugin.

Code references:
- packages/agent-plan/src/index.ts — setup claude-code / setup codex commands and config helpers.
- packages/plan-mcp/src/index.ts — stdio MCP server implementation.
- npm package `@agent-plan/mcp` — the published artifact referenced by configs and registry.
- External: registry.modelcontextprotocol.io submission flow.

Acceptance criteria:
- `agent-plan setup codex` writes a valid `.codex/mcp.json` (project or user scope).
- `agent-plan setup claude-code` keeps working with the full command surface.
- Agent Plan appears in the official MCP registry search/listing.
- README/docs mention install-from-registry once live.
- Build, type-check, and existing harness tests pass.
